module: Node "Format String" (repeat_instant). Applies string.format(data.pattern, values...) with up to 16 values (dynamic input pins value_1..value_N, N set by "Count" in the editor). Output: value (string). Default pattern "%d".
notes: Maximum 16 values: beyond 16, work produces nothing.
A nil value or one of a type incompatible with the format (e.g. %d with a string) makes string.format fail.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

updatePins.desc: Creates or deletes the value_i pins (and the associated links) to go from old to new values.

_onSerialize.desc: Saves the node's state in the given table.

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores count and recreates the pins.

work.desc: Formats the pattern with the values value_1..value_count.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the central content of the node in the editor.
